tasks.name: Add testcontainers-go dependencies
tasks.description: Add the required testcontainers-go dependencies to go.mod to support container-based testing with Oracle XE.
tasks.implementationGuide:
Use `go get` to add the following dependencies to the project:
1. github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go
2. github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go/wait

Make sure the versions are compatible with the current Go version (1.24) used in the project.
tasks.verificationCriteria: The go.mod file should include the testcontainers-go dependencies, and go.sum should be updated accordingly. Verify that `go mod tidy` runs successfully without errors.
tasks.analysisResult: This solution implements integration testing for the go-sqlcl project using testcontainers-go with Oracle XE containers. It creates containerized Oracle databases for testing, eliminating the need for external database installations and making tests more reliable and reproducible. The implementation extends the current test infrastructure rather than replacing it, maintaining compatibility with the existing codebase.

tasks.name: Create container setup infrastructure
tasks.description: Create the directory structure and container setup code for Oracle XE container testing.

relatedFiles.description: Container setup code for Oracle XE

tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Create the test/container/ directory structure
2. Implement the oracle_container.go file with functions to:
   - Start an Oracle XE container
   - Configure port mapping
   - Set up wait strategies
   - Extract connection details

The main function should be `startOracleContainer()` that returns a container instance and connection options compatible with the existing client.
